answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. A new identity starts as a nebula of claims: it posts $25 escrow, then runs a voyage of paid jobs, each checked by verifiers, like trees in a grove, confirming one slice. After 20 verified jobs over 10 epochs the escrow unlocks; a failed check freezes it 5 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs $25,000 plus 20,000 fake jobs, while an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
